system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; model is fine-tuned Pix2Struct with no text prompt. The only input is pixels, with the instruction rendered on the screenshot. No prompt-building place exists in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The only input to the model is pixel-based observation from the environment.
env_context_strategy.note: The paper states the input explicitly. The instruction is rendered onto the screenshot.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we only use the screenshot of the current step in our experiments
context_compaction.note: No history is sent at all; only the current frame is used. This is the closest value. For WebShop the last 5 actions are rendered on the screenshot.

observation_format.evidence_quote: our agent receives pixel-based observations and generates outputs corresponding to mouse and keyboard actions

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We encode actions as text tokens, which are predicted autoregressively by the Transformer decoder.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are a plain-text DSL such as 'click X Y', not JSON. json_in_text is the closest value; the mismatch should be logged as an ambiguity.

tool_count.note: There is no tool schema. The action space has 5 action types (click, begin_drag, end_drag, key, scroll), but these are not tool definitions.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Our action space consists of raw mouse and keyboard actions

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas exist; the action format is learned via fine-tuning.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no repo contents in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: We adopt Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) (Coulom, 2006)
loop_primitives.note: Default is a greedy per-step policy (closest value react; there is no think step). MCTS is used for policy improvement and inference.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The model is called once per time step.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The model is called once per time step.
multi_agent_topology.note: The separate value model used in MCTS is not an agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The model is called once per time step.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we track which actions have been taken for a given observation
short_term_state.note: The state is an action-per-observation set used for cycle avoidance. There is no conversation.

self_verification.note: A value model is used in MCTS for search, not for verification.

rollback.note: MCTS relies on the ability to reset the environment to its initial state (Sec. 7).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Episodes continue until a terminal state or a configurable number of maximum steps is reached.
termination_condition.note: The terminal state is environment-determined, not model-declared.

execution_isolation.note: The agent uses a Selenium-driven Chrome browser. No isolation boundary is described.

network_policy.note: The paper states the models were evaluated only in offline environments.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on MiniWob++ and WebShop, but the repo contents were not available.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This paper focuses on creating agents that interact with the digital world using the same conceptual interface that humans commonly use

open_source.note: The paper states code and models are available on GitHub, but no LICENSE file is in the bundle.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We use the PIX2S TRUCT base variant with 282M parameters
model_agnostic.note: The system is tied to a fine-tuned Pix2Struct model.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code and models are available at https://github.com/google-deepmind/pix2act.
primary_artifact.note: Only the paper was provided; the repo is presumably frozen to the paper.

first_release_date.note: The paper v2 is dated 2023-12-06. The v1 date is not in the evidence.
